Consts

EKeyExpired = 127
EKEYEXPIRED: read-after-KeyUpdate until the new RX key is installed (TLS 1.3). Not in Nim's posix, defined here for convenience. 
IpProtoTcp = 6
IPPROTO_TCP: level used to attach the TLS ULP (TCP_ULP). 
SolTls = 282
SOL_TLS socket level for setsockopt/getsockopt. 
TcpUlp = 31
TCP_ULP: attach a Upper Layer Protocol to a TCP socket.

TlsRxExpectNoPad = 4

TlsTx = 1

Procs

proc rawEnableUlp(fd: SocketHandle): cint {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Attach the "tls" ULP: setsockopt(fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_ULP, "tls"). Must be called on an established TCP socket before rawSetTx/rawSetRx. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error. 
proc rawGetRx(fd: SocketHandle; buf: pointer; len: var SockLen): cint {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Read back the installed RX crypto state (getsockopt(SOL_TLS, TLS_RX)). Fails (non-zero return) when no RX state is installed. 
proc rawGetTx(fd: SocketHandle; buf: pointer; len: var SockLen): cint {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Read back the installed TX crypto state (getsockopt(SOL_TLS, TLS_TX)). Fails (non-zero return) when no TX state is installed. 
proc rawSetRx(fd: SocketHandle; cryptoInfo: pointer; infoLen: SockLen): cint {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Install receive crypto state: setsockopt(fd, SOL_TLS, TLS_RX, ...). Same buffer contract as rawSetTx. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error. 
proc rawSetRxExpectNoPad(fd: SocketHandle; enable: bool): cint {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Hint the kernel to attempt opportunistic zero-copy on receive. The kernel takes a 4-byte flag (0/1) and requires TLS 1.3 with RX already configured — call after rawSetRx. Returns 0/-1. 
proc rawSetTx(fd: SocketHandle; cryptoInfo: pointer; infoLen: SockLen): cint {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Install transmit crypto state: setsockopt(fd, SOL_TLS, TLS_TX, ...). cryptoInfo must point at one of the Tls12CryptoInfo* structs and infoLen must be its size. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error. 
proc rawSetTxMaxPayloadLen(fd: SocketHandle; maxLen: uint16): cint {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Cap the maximum plaintext payload per TLS record (2-byte value, kernel-validated range, at most 16384). Fails with EBUSY while a record is open. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error. 
proc rawSetTxZerocopyRo(fd: SocketHandle; enable: bool): cint {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Toggle TX zerocopy (sendfile) mode. The kernel takes a 4-byte unsigned int flag (0/1). Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.
